description: Search everything Maps Agent publishes about Google Maps and Google Business Profile for local businesses: answers, guides, research, glossary, blog, industry pages. Use it first for any question (getting more Google reviews, choosing a Business Profile category, a suspended profile, ranking in the map pack). Returns ranked pages with title, one-line summary, form, last-updated date and URL; read one in full with get_article.

form.description: Only this form. answer = one question answered first; guide = long reads, troubleshooting and copyable templates; research = our own measurements and statistics with method; glossary = terms; blog = articles; industry = what changes trade by trade; comparison = Maps Agent against other options; changelog = dated Google Business Profile changes.

query.description: The question or keywords in plain English, e.g. 'how to get more Google reviews'.

name: search_knowledge

summary.description: One or two plain sentences: the page's description or opening.

topic.description: Grouping inside the form: answer cluster, guide kind, trade, blog vertical.

updated.description: The page's own last-updated day, YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: The page on maps-agent.com — cite it.

title: Search Maps Agent knowledge
